turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Example: Today I run. Yesterday I ran to the shop. The verb changes to a new word.
Rule: Some verbs do not take -ed, so their past form is a different word.
Right: Last week she saw a film. Wrong: Last week she seed a film.
Now you try.
Write the past form of 'have': Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
